[[File:Kabam daily mission.png|thumb]]
'''Daily Missions''' are solo missions in which [[Spark|Spark Essence]] can be earned.

* ''There are two types of daily missions: the spark trials and the class-specific daily missions.''
* 
* ''DAILY MISSIONS:''
* ''Daily spark trial missions contain chances at basic sparks and basic spark fragments.''
* ''Daily class missions contain chances at class-specific sparks and class-specific spark fragments.''
* ''A screenshot showing daily mission examples''
* 
* ''DAILY MISSION REWARDS:''
* ''Completion rewards require that you simply complete the mission at least once, regardless of exploration percentage.''
* ''Exploration rewards require that you fully explore and complete the mission map, having visited every tile and node.''
* ''Each map will have guaranteed completion rewards and exploration rewards that vary depending on the difficulty of the mission: Easy, Medium, or Hard.''
* 
* ''EXAMPLE OF COMPLETION AND EXPLORATION REWARDS:''
* ''A screenshot showing examples of daily mission completion and exploration rewards''
* 
* ''EXAMPLE OF EXPLORATION REWARDS:''
* ''A screenshot showing examples of completion and exploration rewards''
* 
* ''Note: As seen in the previous image, if you have earned either completion or exploration rewards, you will see a green checkmark next to earned rewards.''
* 
* ''GETTING SPARKS FROM DAILY MISSIONS''
* ''Sparks are NOT awarded for the successful completion of any class spark mission, only spark essence.''
* ''Sparks are rewarded for exploration in easy mode, but not the other modes. The drop is chance-based. Spark essence, however, is guaranteed.''

== Map ==
All days have Spark Trials map, in which there are two maps; An Easy map for Tier 1 Basic Essence, and a Medium map for Tier 2 Essence. Each day focuses on one class, with Sunday a free-for-all for Tier 1 Class Essence for all classes. v6.0 added medium maps to Sunday missions, and in a later update Hard difficulty; and v8.3 added auto-complete and overhauled Sunday to be a T1-3 Class Crystal Trial.
* Monday: Brawler Bash
* Tuesday: Warrior Wars
* Wednesday: Scout Skirmish
* Thursday: Tech Tantrum
* Friday: Demolitions Derby
* Saturday: Tactician Trouble
* Sunday: Free-for-All

Spark Trials are present all week.

Note that the maps and ratings for all Sparks are identical except for Class Spark and Bots encountered on the map.

== Spark Trials ==
[[File:Spark Trials v2.jpg|thumb]]

=== Easy ===
*Energy: 1
*Rating: 300-700
* Completion Rewards: 50 T1 Essence, 125 XP, 125 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1 T1 spark, 225 XP, 350 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**61% 10 Energy:  78 Essence,  317 Gold,  642 XP
**100%  12 Energy:  1 spark & 48 Essence, 650 Gold,  1,030 XP
**+% 11 Energy:  38 Essence, 248 Gold, 661 XP

=== Medium ===
* Energy: 2
*Rating: 900-1500
* Completion Rewards: 200 T2 Essence, 150 XP, 150 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 300 T2 Essence, 300 XP, 440 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**58% 20 Energy:  252 Essence,  600 Gold, 1,315 XP
**100% 24 Energy:  384 Essence, 995 Gold,  2,212 XP
**+% 22 Energy:  68 Essence, 572 Gold, 1,488 XP

=== Hard ===
* Energy: 3
*Rating: 10,000-12,000
**Left Nodes  x4: 70-90 Gold, 12 T3 Essence, (1 T3 Ore ambush and boss)
**Right Nodes x5: 115-152 Gold, 25 T3 Essence
*Completion Rewards: 500 T3 Basic Spark Essence, 250 XP, 250 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1000 T3 Basic Spark Essence, 500 XP, 650 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**56% 30 Energy: 585 Essence, 815 Gold, 1,870 XP
**100% 36 Energy: 1,175 Essence, 1,413 Gold, 3,030 XP
**+% 33 Energy: 135 Essence, 709 Gold, 2,075 XP 

== Crystal Trials ==
[[File:Crystal Trials.jpg|thumb]]
Only available on Sundays.

=== Easy ===

*Rating: 300-700
* Completion Rewards: 1,000 T1 Class Spark Crystal Shards, 125 XP, 125 Gold
*Exploration Rewards:  1 T1 Class Spark Crystal, 225 XP, 350 Gold
*Node rewards: Left x4: 30 Gold, 100 shards, | Right x5: 50 Gold, 160 shards
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**61% 10 Energy: 1,560 shards, 317 Gold, 642 XP
**100% 10 Energy: 1 crystal, 960 shards, 650 Gold, 1,030 XP
**+% 11 Energy: 760 shards, 248 Gold, 661 XP 
***

=== Medium ===

*Rating: 900-1500
* Completion Rewards: 400 T2 Class Spark Crystal Shards, 150 XP, 150 Gold
*Exploration Rewards:  600 T2 Class Spark Crystal Shards, 300 XP, 400 Gold
*Node rewards: Left x4: 61 Gold, 16 shards, | Right x5: 91 Gold, 24 shards | Boss: 122 Gold, 24 Shards, 1 T2 Ore
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**58% 20 Energy: 504 shards, 600 gold, 1,315 XP
**100% 24 Energy: 768 shards, 995 gold 2,212 XP
**+% 22 Energy: 136 shards, 572 Gold, 1,448 XP

=== Hard ===

*Rating: 10,000-12,000
*Completion Rewards: 500 T3 Class Crystal Shards, 250 XP, 250 Gold
* Exploration Rewards: 1,000 T3 Class Crystal Shards, 500 XP, 650 Gold
*Node rewards: Left x4 80~100 Gold, 12 shards | Right x5: ~130 Gold, 25 shards, 1 T3 Ore from ambush
*Autocompletion: 
**56% 30 Energy = 585 T3 Class Crystal Shards, 1,870 XP, 815 Gold
**100% 36 Energy = 1,175 T3 Class Crystal Shards, 3,030 XP, 1,413 Gold
**+% 33 Energy = 135 T3 Class Crystal Shards, 2,075 XP, 709 Gold

== Class Trials ==

=== Easy ===

*Rating: 750-1,050
* Completion Rewards: 50 T1 Essence, 125 XP, 125 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1 T1 Spark, 225 XP, 350 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**61% 10 Energy = 83 T1 Class Spark Essence, 417 Gold, 867 XP
**100%  12 Energy = 1 T1 Spark, 48 T1 Class Spark Essence, 742 Gold, 1,217 XP
**+% 11 Energy = 40 T1 Class Spark Essence, 579 Gold, 1,042 XP

=== Medium ===
* Rating: 1500-2500
* Completion Rewards: 500 T2 Essence, 150 XP, 150 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1 T2 Class Spark, 300 XP, 400 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**62% 20 Energy = 687 T2 Class Essence, 705 Gold, 1,767 XP
**100% 24 Energy =  1 T2 Class Spark, 282 T2 Class Essence, 1,145 Gold, 2,482 XP
**+% 22 Energy  = 234 T2 Class Spark Essence, 925 Gold, 2,124 XP

=== Hard ===
* Rating: 10,000-12,000
*Completion Rewards: 500 T3 Essence, 250 XP, 250 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1,000 T3 Essence, 500 XP, 650 Gold
*Autocompletion Rewards:
**62% 30 Energy = 585 T3 Class Spark Essence,  805 Gold, 1,867 XP
**100% 36 Energy = 1,150 T3 Class Spark Essence, 1,395 Gold, 2,682 XP
**+% 33 Energy = 117 T3 Class Spark Essence, 1,100 Gold, 2,274 XP

== Titan Cycles ==
[[File:Titan Cycles header.jpg|thumb]]
Introduced version 8.4 April 2020, Titan Cycles are available for three days on [[Alliance Mission]] off-days, These three-Bot, three-path 5-Star missions award Elite Alliance Crystal shards, [[Titan Fragments]], and from nodes Tier 1 Alliance Mission Repair and Revive Kits, and sometimes chests of 250 or 500 shards. There is no autocompletion option. Its one chapter is called Fetch.

=== Fetch ===

*Energy: 1/Node
*Completion Rewards: 1,000 Elite Alliance Crystal Shards, 80 Titan Fragments, 250 XP, 500 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 1,000 Elite Alliance Crystal Shards, 200 Titan Fragments, 500 XP, 1,000 Gold
*Rating: 7000-22000
**Center path: x5 ~1,500~ rating, ~700 Gold +T2 Ore-13
**Left class gate path: x6 ~6,000~ rating~, ~1200 Gold
**Right class-of-the-day gate path x6 ~3,000 rating~, 850 Gold

== Spark Supply Drop ==
After a medium map is completed, a limited-time offer becomes available for 1 hour. 

The basic Spark Supply Drop costs 100 Energon and contains:
* 1 T2 Basic Spark
* 5 T2 Ore-13
* 5000 Gold
A Class Spark Supply Double Drop costs 350 Energon and contains:
* 2 Tier 2 Class Spark
* 3 Tier 3 Class Ore-13
* 8000 Gold
